notes: All four old kinds kept (Sorghum, Millet, Maize, Banana beer) with their old sources; Sahti, Gluten-free beer and Fruit & spice beer added with Wikipedia sources. Gluten-free branded models moved out of Sorghum and Millet beer into Gluten-free beer (Redbridge, Green's Endeavour, Glutenberg Blonde). Concrete Jungle kept in Maize beer m from old data, unconfirmed as a maize beer. Raha, Agashya, Against the Grain, Kukko Pils makers not given on retrieved pages, left blank. Fruit lambics (kriek, framboise) belong to the Sour & wild shelf, not repeated here. Left out: chili beer (no page found), Omission/Daura and other gluten-reduced brands (not on retrieved pages), sahti TSG year, Redbridge maker, founding years for Chibuku and Lakefront.
